title: Loafer
desc: Raja, a young thief, lives with his father and believes his mother to be dead. However, things become complicated when he comes across Mouni, a runaway girl, and falls for her.

title: Azhagu Kutti Chellam
desc: The lives of several families become intertwined over a common thread between them.

title: Kumki
desc: Bomman, a mahout, and his elephant are assigned to protect the crops of a hill tribe from a rogue elephant. However, his life takes a turn when he falls in love with the village leader's daughter.

title: F2: Fun and Frustration
desc: Two young men hope to control their wives after their respective marriages. However, their chauvinistic attitude often lands them in hilarious situations.

title: Takkar
desc: A man who wants to be a millionaire meets a woman with a distaste for money. Their chance encounter, however, leads to an unexpected adventure.

title: Hanu Man
desc: A local thief, who lives in the village of Anjanadri, comes across a Hanuman-like power. He must protect people from the peril that looms over them.

title: Kazhugumalai Ganesh
desc: A film-maker aspires to make a gangster movie and selects the hardened Gaddalakonda Ganesh as his subject. Soon, he and his friend put their lives on the line to follow Gaddalakonda's life.

title: Paranthu Po
desc: A struggling father and his stubborn son take on a road trip to escape the pressures of their daily lives and along the way discover the valuable things missing from their lives.

title: Stree
desc: In the eerie townscape of Chanderi, dressmaker Vicky falls for a mysterious woman with a supernatural aura. His heart sinks at the possibility that she might be Stree, the resentful man-hunter.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Yevanda
desc: A young man working as a collection agent for a bank discovers that a couple are conning gullible people out of their money. He decides to give them a taste of their own medicine and falls in love.

title: Deja Vu
desc: An undercover police inspector investigates a mysterious abduction case of the daughter of the director general of police of a state which bears similarity with the description of a crime novelist.

title: Panchamugi
desc: Panchamukhi, a wife and mother, leaves her family devastated when she dies according to a prophecy by Goddess Durga. However, her grieving husband encounters an exact lookalike of her in the city.

title: Mandela
desc: In a small village, two political parties compete in the local elections and are ready to win at any cost. In a twist of fate, the single deciding vote comes down to a small-time barber.

title: Manam
desc: Bittu, a six-year-old, loses his parents in an unfortunate car accident. Thirty years later, he comes across two collegians who look exactly like his late parents' young selves.

title: Avan Ivan
desc: A benevolent landlord embraces two half-brothers as his chosen family, nurturing their dreams, but their lives take a perilous turn when they cross paths with a notorious cattle smuggler.

title: Veera Simha Reddy
desc: Jai Simha Reddy, the son of the esteemed Veera Simha Reddy, returns home to avenge his father's death as a result of village politics.
